recap.text: Donut lies still while Rosetta shaves a round bald patch on her right flank and Edgar, the poker in his mouth, tattoos a dog over it. She agreed only because Carl gets a matching one. Milk writes Words of Power over it in black and then purple ink, and the line-drawn dog lifts its leg and licks itself. Bijanbi, from Wepwawet, jumps from level two to a temporary level fifteen.

Donut's Astral Paw sweeps the bridge clear of the cannibals throwing themselves at the truck's shield. It is far smaller than her War Crime, which she cannot cast again until the twelfth floor, and the Paw is stronger now, with an eight-hour cooldown. She says the combined version with Bijanbi is no new spell, only the two cast together. Then she jumps, hits the cab's roof and spins round, certain the stupid dog tattoo on her butt just bit her.

beats.headline: It has to be a tattoo
beats.text: It has to be a tattoo, Rosetta says, and Milk will etch words of power over it to raise the spell's level. Hamzo would not reach wide enough, so they chose a Dinner Bell variant from a cleric who fell defending the FUPA, which Edgar has extracted; it used to be called Heel, and this season it is Bijanbi. Donut never agreed to a tattoo. She will do it only if Carl gets a matching one. Rosetta shaves a small, round bald patch on her right flank, and Edgar, the poker in his mouth, says what he is drawing: a dog.
beats.gist: Rosetta shaves Donut's flank and Edgar draws a dog, because Donut wants Carl tattooed too.

beats.headline: Two very rude achievements
beats.text: Donut does not look at the tattoo on her flank. She stares forward with quiet dignity while Edgar works, and then he drops his tattoo stick and asks if it worked. Why are you asking me, she cries. She has two very rude achievements, one calling her a traitor, one paying out a stolen catalytic converter. And the spell, Bijanbi, only level two, came from a god called Wepwawet in the Court of Nekhebit; she may worship him now, and Odette too. Cover it up, she says; they will get it lasered off on the next floor.
beats.gist: Donut sits through Edgar's tattooing, then learns the tattoo gave her two rude achievements and the spell Bijanbi.

beats.headline: Words of power
beats.text: Not quite yet, says Milk: it must be temporarily above level eight. Her pen writes over the tattoo in a script the system calls Words of Power, first in black ink and then purple, a calligraphy-guild magic. The letters glow and move, and under them Carl sees the shape: a simple, rather adorable line drawing of a dog. It lifts its leg and starts to lick itself. Edgar doubts it is sentient. Donut gasps: the spell is level fifteen. Temporary, Milk says; it fades with the ink, but it helps the training.
beats.gist: Milk's pen writes Words of Power over Donut's dog tattoo, and a line-drawn dog starts licking itself.

beats.headline: It bites
beats.text: Cannibals throw themselves at the truck's shield. Donut's Astral Paw sweeps the bridge clear, far smaller than her War Crime, which she cannot cast again until the twelfth floor; the Paw is stronger now, with an eight-hour cooldown. The combined version with Bijanbi is not a new spell, she says: she can cast the two together. Then she jumps, hits the cab's roof and spins round. She thinks the stupid dog tattoo on her butt just bit her.
beats.gist: Donut's Astral Paw sweeps the bridge clear of cannibals, then the dog tattoo on her butt bites her.
